method.scope: Installed Node direct source+source-phrase owners; frozen adversarial records. Browser/worker/UI, retained/peak heap and physical-input timings are Not measured.
method.timing: Three fresh ordinary child processes per variant/size; two verified excluded warmups then six measured queries per case. Separate diagnostic child has one observation per query and no warmups. Build and two replacement operations are separate windows. Imports, fixture generation, owner creation, verification, result serialization and teardown are outside windows. CPU user/system differ from wall.
method.rotation: Four rounds, alternating size and variant order; diagnostic placement rotates by size. All processes run sequentially.
method.matching: Complete frozen membership gives exact totals and top20 eligibility; successful native result objects, mutation receipts and typed errors compare exactly across every owner/variant, including warmups. No resource transition is accepted as exact parity.
method.quantiles: Descriptive medians/observed maxima only; no p95 or statistical-significance claim. Refused samples and their elapsed times remain explicit.
method.diagnostics: Only disposable installed copies are instrumented. Prefix visits mean actual examined hash-directory terms or ordered-tree nodes; profile/source anchors retained. Normal package inventories and harness hashes checked before/after; no overhead subtraction.

source.method: Cycle 34 frozen technical-document sections; retain heading plus a whitespace-bounded excerpt at most 512 UTF-16 code units. Repetitions are labeled and are not independent real documents.
source.limits: Single English technical self-documentation corpus, repeated excerpts and deterministic synthetic lexical controls; no representative traffic or relevance-quality claim.
